canonical_statement: Candidate claim family only: for a real-valued function on Euclidean R^n in a suitable L1 and first-order L2 Sobolev class, its L2 norm is bounded by a dimension-dependent combination of its L1 norm and the L2 norm of its gradient.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: n : Nat with 0 < n; f : (Fin n -> Real) -> Real; exact function-space packaging not frozen
hypotheses: provisionally f has finite L2 norm
provisionally f has an L2 weak gradient
conclusion: A Nash interpolation bound between the L2 quantity, L1 quantity, and Dirichlet energy; exact exponents and normalization await primary-source audit
excluded_scope: Nash entropy and entropy-power inequalities unless a source audit identifies them as the intended record
manifold, graph, discrete, and semigroup generalizations
degenerate_cases: The zero function, n = 0, and extended-real/infinite norm cases require explicit statement choices and mutation tests.
foundation_profile: Not instantiated; measure theory, weak derivatives, classical logic, choice, and quotient use remain to be audited
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus a future pinned mathlib environment; exact versions and transitive closure remain open
computation_profile: No computation or oracle is credited at intake
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib, pending statement phase
source_revisions: John Nash, Continuity of solutions of parabolic and elliptic equations, American Journal of Mathematics 80(4), 1958, 931-954; immutable copy/hash and pinpoint pending
